items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides support for marking the ApplicationContext associated with a test as dirty for both test classes and test methods annotated with the @DirtiesContext annotation.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 为支持将带有 @DirtiesContext 注解的测试类和测试方法关联的 ApplicationContext 标记为 dirty（脏）提供支持。

items.source: Extended variant of the standard ApplicationListener interface, exposing further metadata such as the supported event and source type.
items.translation: 标准 `ApplicationListener` 接口的扩展变体，暴露了更多元数据，例如支持的事件和源类型。

items.source: HandlerResultHandler that encapsulates the view resolution algorithm supporting the following return types: Void, void, or no value -- default view name String -- view name unless @ModelAttribute-annotated View -- View to render with Model -- attributes to add to the model Map -- attributes to add to the model Rendering -- use case driven API for view resolution @ModelAttribute -- attribute for the model Non-simple value -- attribute for the model
items.translation: 封装视图解析算法的 HandlerResultHandler，支持以下返回类型： Void、void 或无值 -- 默认视图名称 String -- 视图名称，除非带有 @ModelAttribute 注解 View -- 用于渲染的视图 Model -- 添加到模型中的属性 Map -- 添加到模型中的属性 Rendering -- 视图解析的用例驱动 API @ModelAttribute -- 模型属性 非简单值 -- 模型属性

items.source: Handles return values of type HttpEntity, ResponseEntity, HttpHeaders, ErrorResponse, and ProblemDetail.
items.translation: 处理类型为HttpEntity、ResponseEntity、HttpHeaders、ErrorResponse和ProblemDetail的返回值。

items.source: Extension of AbstractAdvisingBeanPostProcessor which implements BeanFactoryAware, adds exposure of the original target class for each proxied bean (AutoProxyUtils.ORIGINAL_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE), and participates in an externally enforced target-class mode for any given bean (AutoProxyUtils.PRESERVE_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE).
items.translation: 扩展了实现BeanFactoryAware的AbstractAdvisingBeanPostProcessor，为每个代理 bean 暴露原始目标类（AutoProxyUtils.ORIGINAL_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE），并参与任何给定 bean 的外部强制目标类模式（AutoProxyUtils.PRESERVE_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE）。

items.source: Extension of TransactionalEventListenerFactory, detecting invalid transaction configuration for transactional event listeners: Transactional only supported with Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW and Propagation.NOT_SUPPORTED.
items.translation: `TransactionalEventListenerFactory` 的扩展，用于检测事务性事件监听器的无效事务配置：仅支持 `Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW` 和 `Propagation.NOT_SUPPORTED` 的 `Transactional`。

items.source: Specialization of PlaceholderConfigurerSupport that resolves ${...} placeholders within bean definition property values and @Value annotations against the current Spring Environment and its set of PropertySources.
items.translation: `PlaceholderConfigurerSupport` 类的特化版本，用于在当前 SpringEnvironment及其一组PropertySources中解析 bean 定义属性值内的 ${...}占位符以及@Value注解。

items.source: Extension of the Ordered interface, expressing a priority ordering: PriorityOrdered objects are always applied before plain Ordered objects regardless of their order values.
items.translation: 对 `Ordered` 接口的扩展，表达一种优先级排序：PriorityOrdered对象总是应用在普通的Ordered对象之前，无论其顺序值如何。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that provides support for executing SQL scripts and inlined statements configured via the @Sql annotation.
items.translation: 提供对通过 `@Sql` 注解配置的 SQL scripts 和行内 statements 执行支持的TestExecutionListener。

items.source: HandlerAdapter that allows DispatcherHandler to support handlers of type WebSocketHandler with such handlers mapped to URL patterns via SimpleUrlHandlerMapping.
items.translation: 支持 `DispatcherHandler` 处理类型为 `WebSocketHandler` 的处理器，并通过 `SimpleUrlHandlerMapping` 将这些处理器映射到 URL 模式的 `HandlerAdapter`。

items.source: Simple BeanFactoryPostProcessor implementation that registers custom Scope(s) with the containing ConfigurableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 简单的BeanFactoryPostProcessor实现，用于向包含的ConfigurableBeanFactory注册自定义的Scope(s)。

items.source: TransactionSynchronization implementation that manages a ResourceHolder bound through TransactionSynchronizationManager.
items.translation: TransactionSynchronization 实现，用于管理通过 TransactionSynchronizationManager 绑定的 ResourceHolder。

items.source: as of 5.2, to be removed in 8.0; use org.springframework.context.support.PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer instead which is more flexible through taking advantage of the Environment and PropertySource mechanisms.
items.translation: 自 5.2 版本起，将在 8.0 版本中移除；请使用 org.springframework.context.support.PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer 替代，它通过利用Environment和PropertySource机制提供了更高的灵活性。

items.source: AspectJPointcutAdvisor adapts an AbstractAspectJAdvice to the PointcutAdvisor interface.
items.translation: AspectJPointcutAdvisor 适配一个 AbstractAspectJAdvice 到 PointcutAdvisor 接口。

items.source: Specialization of AsyncExecutionInterceptor that delegates method execution to an Executor based on the Async annotation.
items.translation: `AsyncExecutionInterceptor` 的专用类，该专用类根据 `Async` 注解将方法执行委托给一个 `Executor`。

items.source: Abstract base class for TestExecutionListener implementations that provide support for marking the ApplicationContext associated with a test as dirty for both test classes and test methods annotated with the @DirtiesContext annotation.
items.translation: 用于提供支持的 `` 实现的抽象基类，该支持可将带有 `@DirtiesContext` 注解的测试类和测试方法关联的 `` 标记为 dirty。

items.source: Implementation of AspectInstanceFactory that creates a new instance of the specified aspect class for every SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现一个AspectInstanceFactory，为每次SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance()调用创建一个新的指定方面类实例。

items.source: Implementation of AspectInstanceFactory that is backed by a specified singleton object, returning the same instance for every SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现由指定单例对象支持的 AspectInstanceFactory，每次调用 SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() 时返回相同的实例。

items.source: Subinterface of AspectInstanceFactory that returns AspectMetadata associated with AspectJ-annotated classes.
items.translation: `AspectInstanceFactory` 接口的子接口，用于返回与 AspectJ 注解类关联的 `AspectMetadata`。

items.source: AspectInstanceFactory implementation backed by a Spring BeanFactory.
items.translation: 由 Spring BeanFactory 支持的AspectInstanceFactory实现。

items.source: AspectInstanceFactory backed by a BeanFactory-provided prototype, enforcing prototype semantics.
items.translation: 由 `BeanFactory` 提供的原型支持的、基于 `AspectInstanceFactory` 的实例，强制执行原型语义。

items.source: Implementation of MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory that creates a new instance of the specified aspect class for every SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现 MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory，为每次SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() 调用创建指定方面类的新实例。

items.source: Implementation of MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory that is backed by a specified singleton object, returning the same instance for every SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现由指定单例对象支持的 MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory，每次调用 SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() 时返回相同的实例。

items.source: Implementation of AspectInstanceFactory that locates the aspect from the BeanFactory using a configured bean name.
items.translation: 实现一个 `AspectInstanceFactory`，该实现使用配置的 Bean 名称从 `BeanFactory` 中定位切面。

items.source: Base class for BeanPostProcessor implementations that apply a Spring AOP Advisor to specific beans.
items.translation: 适用于将 Spring AOPAdvisor 应用于特定 Bean 的 BeanPostProcessor 实现的基础类。

items.source: Abstract generic PointcutAdvisor that allows for any Advice to be configured.
items.translation: 抽象通用PointcutAdvisor，允许配置任何Advice。

items.source: BeanInfoFactory implementation that performs standard Introspector inspection.
items.translation: 实现 BeanInfoFactory 接口以执行标准的 Introspector 检查。

items.source: BeanFactoryPostProcessor implementation that allows for convenient registration of custom property editors.
items.translation: BeanFactoryPostProcessor 实现，允许方便地注册自定义 属性编辑器。

items.source: BeanFactoryPostProcessor used for bootstrapping processing of @Configuration classes.
items.translation: 用于引导处理 `BeanFactoryPostProcessor` 的`@Configuration` 类。

items.source: A BeanPostProcessor that honours ImportAware callback using a mapping computed at build time.
items.translation: 一个在构建时计算映射，以使用 `ImportAware` 回调的 `BeanPostProcessor`。

items.source: GenericApplicationListener adapter that delegates the processing of an event to an EventListener annotated method.
items.translation: GenericApplicationListener 适配器，将事件的处理委托给由 EventListener 注解的方法。

items.source: Default EventListenerFactory implementation that supports the regular EventListener annotation.
items.translation: 默认支持常规EventListener注解的EventListenerFactory实现。

items.source: ApplicationListener decorator that filters events from a specified event source, invoking its delegate listener for matching ApplicationEvent objects only.
items.translation: ApplicationListener 装饰器用于过滤来自指定事件源的事件，仅对匹配的 ApplicationEvent 对象调用其委托监听器。

items.source: Bean post-processor that automatically applies persistence exception translation to any bean marked with Spring's @Repository annotation, adding a corresponding PersistenceExceptionTranslationAdvisor to the exposed proxy (either an existing AOP proxy or a newly generated proxy that implements all of the target's interfaces).
items.translation: 自动将持久化异常转换应用于任何标记有 Spring 的 `@Repository` 注解的 Bean 的后处理器，并向暴露的代理（现有的 AOP 代理或新生成的实现目标所有接口的代理）添加相应的 `PersistenceExceptionTranslationAdvisor`。

items.source: Bean post-processor that registers methods annotated with JmsListener to be invoked by a JMS message listener container created under the cover by a JmsListenerContainerFactory according to the attributes of the annotation.
items.translation: 注册带有JmsListener注解的方法，以便由在幕后由JmsListenerContainerFactory创建的 JMS 消息监听器容器根据该注解的属性进行调用。

items.source: Bean post-processor that automatically applies asynchronous invocation behavior to any bean that carries the Async annotation at class or method-level by adding a corresponding AsyncAnnotationAdvisor to the exposed proxy (either an existing AOP proxy or a newly generated proxy that implements all the target's interfaces).
items.translation: 自动将异步调用行为应用于任何在类或方法级别携带 Async 注解的 Bean 的后处理器，通过向暴露的代理（现有的 AOP 代理或新生成的实现目标所有接口的代理）添加相应的 AsyncAnnotationAdvisor。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that provides support for executing tests within test-managed transactions by honoring Spring's @Transactional annotation.
items.translation: 提供对在执行测试管理的事务内运行测试的支持的TestExecutionListener，通过尊重 Spring 的@Transactional注解。

items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides mock Servlet API support to WebApplicationContexts loaded by the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 为通过 Spring TestContext Framework 加载的 WebApplicationContexts 提供模拟 Servlet API 支持。

items.source: An ApplicationListener that is invoked according to a TransactionPhase.
items.translation: 一个根据TransactionPhase调用的ApplicationListener。

items.source: TransactionalApplicationListener adapter that delegates the processing of an event to a target ApplicationListener instance.
items.translation: TransactionalApplicationListener 适配器，将事件的处理委托给目标 ApplicationListener 实例。

items.source: GenericApplicationListener adapter that delegates the processing of an event to a TransactionalEventListener annotated method.
items.translation: `GenericApplicationListener` 适配器，它将事件的处理委托给一个由 `TransactionalEventListener` 注解标记的方法。

items.source: EventListenerFactory implementation that handles TransactionalEventListener annotated methods.
items.translation: 处理带有TransactionalEventListener注解方法的EventListenerFactory实现。

items.source: Extension of HttpServiceGroupConfigurer to configure groups with a RestClient.
items.translation: 扩展HttpServiceGroupConfigurer以使用RestClient配置组。

items.source: Extension of HttpServiceGroupConfigurer to configure groups with a WebClient.
items.translation: 扩展HttpServiceGroupConfigurer以使用WebClient配置组。

items.source: HandlerResultHandler that handles return values from methods annotated with @ResponseBody writing to the body of the request or response with an HttpMessageWriter.
items.translation: 处理带有 @ResponseBody 注解的方法的返回值，并使用HttpMessageWriter将其写入请求或响应的正文中的HandlerResultHandler。

items.source: Abstract base class for HandlerExceptionResolver implementations that support handling exceptions from handlers of type HandlerMethod.
items.translation: 支持处理类型为HandlerMethod的处理器异常的HandlerExceptionResolver实现的抽象基类。

items.source: A HandlerExceptionResolver that delegates to a list of other HandlerExceptionResolvers.
items.translation: 一个委托给其他 HandlerExceptionResolver 列表的 HandlerExceptionResolver。

items.source: AOP Alliance MethodInterceptor that processes method invocations asynchronously, using a given AsyncTaskExecutor.
items.translation: 异步处理方法调用的 AOP Alliance MethodInterceptor，使用给定的AsyncTaskExecutor。

items.source: Extension of StandardBeanInfoFactory that supports "non-standard" JavaBeans setter methods through introspection by Spring's (package-visible) ExtendedBeanInfo implementation.
items.translation: 扩展了StandardBeanInfoFactory，支持通过 Spring 的（包可见）ExtendedBeanInfo实现进行内省以处理“非标准”JavaBeans setter 方法。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that enables @BeanOverride support in tests, by injecting overridden beans in appropriate fields of the test instance.
items.translation: 支持在测试中注入覆盖的 Bean 到测试实例的适当字段中的TestExecutionListener，从而启用对@BeanOverride的支持。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that resets any mock beans that have been marked with a MockReset.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 会重置所有已标记为带有 MockReset 的模拟 Bean。

items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides support for ApplicationEvents.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 提供对 ApplicationEvents 的支持。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that publishes test execution events to the ApplicationContext for the currently executing test.
items.translation: 发布测试执行事件到当前正在执行的测试的 ApplicationContext 的 TestExecutionListener。

items.source: Abstract ordered implementation of the TestExecutionListener API.
items.translation: 抽象的 `ordered` 实现，用于 `ordered` 接口，该接口实现了 TestExecutionListener API。

items.source: HandlerResultHandler implementation that supports ServerResponses.
items.translation: 支持ServerResponse的HandlerResultHandler实现。

items.source: Base class for HandlerResultHandler with support for content negotiation and access to a ReactiveAdapter registry.
items.translation: `HandlerResultHandler` 接口的基类，支持内容协商并可以访问 `ReactiveAdapter` 注册表。

items.source: HandlerAdapter implementation that supports HandlerFunctions.
items.translation: 支持HandlerFunction的HandlerAdapter实现。

items.source: as of 5.2, along with PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer; to be removed in 8.0
items.translation: 自 5.2 版本起，连同PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer；将在 8.0 版本中移除。

items.source: as of 5.3, in favor of the default methods on the TransactionSynchronization interface
items.translation: 自 5.3 版本起，转而使用 TransactionSynchronization 接口上的默认方法。

items.source: AspectJAwareAdvisorAutoProxyCreator subclass that processes all AspectJ annotation aspects in the current application context, as well as Spring Advisors.
items.translation: AspectJAwareAdvisorAutoProxyCreator 子类处理当前应用程序上下文中的所有 AspectJ 注解切面以及 Spring Advisor。

items.source: Decorator to cause a MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory to instantiate only once.
items.translation: 装饰器，用于使MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory仅实例化一次。

items.source: AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator subclass that exposes AspectJ's invocation context and understands AspectJ's rules for advice precedence when multiple pieces of advice come from the same aspect.
items.translation: AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator 子类，它暴露了 AspectJ 的调用上下文，并理解当多个通知来自同一个切面时 AspectJ 的通知优先级规则。

items.source: Base class with common functionality for proxy processors, in particular ClassLoader management and the ProxyProcessorSupport.evaluateProxyInterfaces(Class, ProxyFactory) algorithm.
items.translation: 包含代理处理器通用功能的基类，特别是 `ClassLoader` 管理和 `ProxyProcessorSupport.evaluateProxyInterfaces(Class, ProxyFactory)` 算法。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that wraps each eligible bean with an AOP proxy, delegating to specified interceptors before invoking the bean itself.
items.translation: 实现BeanPostProcessor，用 AOP 代理包裹每个符合条件的 Bean，在调用该 Bean 之前委托给指定的拦截器。

items.source: Abstract base class for PointcutAdvisor implementations.
items.translation: 抽象基类，用于PointcutAdvisor实现。

items.source: Simple IntroductionAdvisor implementation that by default applies to any class.
items.translation: 简单的IntroductionAdvisor实现，默认适用于任何类。

items.source: Convenient class for regexp method pointcuts that hold an Advice, making them an Advisor.
items.translation: 用于持有 Advice 的 regexp 方法点切面的便捷类，使其成为 Advisor。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that autowires annotated fields, setter methods, and arbitrary config methods.
items.translation: BeanPostProcessor实现，用于自动装配带注解的字段、setter 方法和任意配置方法。

items.source: A BeanFactoryPostProcessor implementation that allows for convenient registration of custom autowire qualifier types.
items.translation: 一个允许方便地注册自定义自动装配限定符类型的BeanFactoryPostProcessor实现。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that invokes annotated init and destroy methods.
items.translation: 实现`BeanPostProcessor`接口以调用已注解的初始化方法和销毁方法。

items.source: GenericApplicationListener adapter that determines supported event types through introspecting the generically declared type of the target listener.
items.translation: 用于通过内省目标监听器泛型声明的类型来确定支持的事件类型的GenericApplicationListener适配器。

items.source: A convenient BeanPostProcessor implementation that delegates to a JSR-303 provider for performing method-level validation on annotated methods.
items.translation: 一个方便的BeanPostProcessor实现，它委托给 JSR-303 提供者以在注解方法上执行方法级验证。

items.source: Encapsulates information about an @ControllerAdvice Spring-managed bean without necessarily requiring it to be instantiated.
items.translation: 封装了关于 `@ControllerAdvice` 的信息，是一个 Spring 管理的 Bean，但不一定需要将其实例化。

items.source: Abstract base class for result handlers that handle return values by writing to the response with HttpMessageWriter.
items.translation: 用于通过 `HttpMessageWriter` 将返回值写入响应来处理返回值的抽象基类。

items.source: Callback to configure the set of declared HttpServiceGroups.
items.translation: 回调以配置声明的HttpServiceGroup集合。

items.source: Abstract base class for HandlerExceptionResolver implementations.
items.translation: 用于 `HandlerExceptionResolver` 实现的抽象基类。

items.source: HandlerExceptionResolver implementation that allows for mapping exception class names to view names, either for a set of given handlers or for all handlers in the DispatcherServlet.
items.translation: 实现`HandlerExceptionResolver`接口，允许将异常类名映射到视图名称，这可以针对一组给定的处理器或针对`DispatcherServlet`中的所有处理器。

items.source: The default implementation of the HandlerExceptionResolver interface, resolving standard Spring MVC exceptions and translating them to corresponding HTTP status codes.
items.translation: 默认实现HandlerExceptionResolver接口，解析标准的 Spring MVC 异常并将其转换为相应的 HTTP 状态码。

items.source: Support classes for the integration of FreeMarker as Spring web view technology.
items.translation: 支持将 FreeMarker 集成作为 Spring Web 视图技术的类。

items.source: Support classes for views based on the JSR-223 script engine abstraction.
items.translation: 支持基于 JSR-223 脚本引擎抽象的视图类。

items.translation: Spring AOP 建议包装 AspectJ 后置建议方法。

items.source: Spring AOP advice wrapping an AspectJ after-returning advice method.
items.translation: Spring AOP 建议包装 AspectJ 返回后建议方法。

items.source: Spring AOP advice wrapping an AspectJ after-throwing advice method.
items.translation: Spring AOP 建议包装了 AspectJ 的 after-throwing 切面方法。

items.source:
Spring AOP around advice (MethodInterceptor) that wraps
an AspectJ advice method.
items.translation: 环绕通知（MethodInterceptor）包装了 AspectJ 通知方法。

items.source: Spring AOP Advisor that can be used for any AspectJ pointcut expression.
items.translation: 可用于任何 AspectJ 点切面表达式的 Spring AOP Advisor。

items.source: Spring AOP advice that wraps an AspectJ before method.
items.translation: 环绕 AspectJ 前置通知的 Spring AOP 建议。

items.source: Synthetic advisor that instantiates the aspect.
items.translation: 合成顾问，用于实例化该切面。

items.source:
Generic auto proxy creator that builds AOP proxies for specific beans
based on detected Advisors for each bean.
items.translation: 通用自动代理创建器，它根据每个 Bean 检测到的 Advisor 为特定 Bean 构建 AOP 代理。

items.source: Auto proxy creator that identifies beans to proxy via a list of names.
items.translation: 自动代理创建器，通过名称列表来识别需要代理的 Bean。

items.source:
Auto-proxy creator that considers infrastructure Advisor beans only,
ignoring any application-defined Advisors.
items.translation: 仅考虑基础设施 Advisor 的自动代理创建器，忽略任何应用程序定义的 Advisor。

items.source:
Abstract BeanFactory-based PointcutAdvisor that allows for any Advice
to be configured as reference to an Advice bean in a BeanFactory.
items.translation: 基于抽象 BeanFactory 的切点 Advisor，允许将任何 Advice 配置为 BeanFactory 中 Advice bean 的引用。

items.source:
Concrete BeanFactory-based PointcutAdvisor that allows for any Advice
to be configured as reference to an Advice bean in the BeanFactory,
as well as the Pointcut to be configured through a bean property.
items.translation: 基于 Concrete BeanFactory 的 PointcutAdvisor，允许将任何 Advice 配置为 BeanFactory 中 Advice bean 的引用，同时通过 bean 属性配置 Pointcut。

items.source: Convenient Pointcut-driven Advisor implementation.
items.translation: 方便的基于切面的顾问实现。

items.source:
Convenient class for name-match method pointcuts that hold an Advice,
making them an Advisor.
items.translation: 用于名称匹配方法切面的便捷类，它持有 Advice 并将其转换为 Advisor。

items.source: Convenient base class for Advisors that are also static pointcuts.
items.translation: 适用于也是静态切面的 Advisor 的便捷基类。

items.source:
Abstract base class for property resource configurers that resolve placeholders
in bean definition property values.
items.translation: 用于解析 Bean 定义属性值中占位符的属性资源配置器的抽象基类。

items.source:
Property resource configurer that overrides bean property values in an application
context definition.
items.translation: 用于在应用程序上下文定义中覆盖 Bean 属性值的属性资源配置器。

items.source:
Allows for configuration of individual bean property values from a property resource,
i.e.
items.translation: 允许从属性资源中配置单个 Bean 的属性值，即。

items.source: Spring AOP exception translation aspect for use at Repository or DAO layer level.
items.translation: 用于在 Repository 或 DAO 层级别的 Spring AOP 异常翻译切面。

items.source:
Represents a Spring-managed bean with cross-cutting functionality to be
applied to one or more Spring beans with annotation-based message
handling methods.
items.translation: 表示一个由 Spring 管理的 Bean，具有切面功能，可应用于一个或多个带有基于注解的消息处理方法（annotation-based message handling methods）的 Spring Bean。

items.source: Interface for transaction synchronization callbacks.
items.translation: 事务同步回调的接口。

items.source: Abstract base class for template view resolvers, in particular for FreeMarker views.
items.translation: 模板视图解析器的抽象基类，特别是针对 FreeMarker 视图。
